private_repository_projection.reason: Private topology is not required for public contribution/product understanding. Exact names, roles and descriptions remain in private owner-authorized registries.

privacy_law: A public organization registry must not enumerate private repository names merely because the owner connector can see them.
Normal users and contributors receive no private repository access by default.
Selected human developers may receive explicit least-privilege access through owner-authorized scoped grants.
limitations: This is the connected GitHub denominator, not the full One-Fabric dormant capability denominator.
Repository existence does not prove deployment, runtime health, productivity or current capability.
Counts require refresh when connected GitHub installation visibility changes.
